latest_release.body:
Niubash v1.5.2 packages for Windows, Linux, and macOS.

Engine: rubash git d63287553235 — every platform build in this release compiled that same revision, pinned by `scripts/release/rubash-pin.json` and fail-hard verified at fetch time (rubash#827). The release compiles the pinned engine, not "whatever rubash master was when the pipeline ran".
Verify locally with `niu --version`, which prints the same revision.

Windows (x64, ARM64): Inno Setup installers (`*-setup.exe`) add user PATH and Windows Terminal profile integration; portable archives bundle `niu` with WinuxCmd and bash/sh shims.

Portable download guide (niubash#470): prefer `*.tar.gz` — it is hardlink-native. The bundled payload ships real NTFS hardlinks (the whole `git.exe` family is one shared binary, `awk`/`gawk` likewise, exactly what `wpm install` lays down), so the tarball is roughly half the zip's download size and unpacks to a much smaller on-disk tree; `tar -xf <file>.tar.gz` works out of the box on Windows 10 1803+ and any modern Linux/macOS, and on a filesystem without hardlink support (FAT32/exFAT) extraction degrades gracefully to independent byte-identical copies with no loss of function. `*.7z` is the smallest download (solid LZMA already collapses the shared payloads) but current 7-Zip releases restore the shared families as independent copies — every file is byte-identical, only disk usage grows. The classic `*.zip` is unchanged, stores every payload in full, and remains for tooling that only speaks zip.

Windows packages come with the must-install bundle pre-installed (niubash#189, niubash#209): niugit (native Windows git — the full plugin distro's five entries install through git, so a fresh machine without git.exe no longer fails `niu setup`), gawk 5.4.1 with plain `awk` working too, plus ripgrep (`rg`) and fd — all landing in the bundled WinuxCmd root as wpm JSON-package payloads, assembled at CI time with no runtime downloads, no runtime archive formats, and no symlinks. Pre-install is best-effort, not a promise: on legs where the package index has no matching artifact (currently niugit and gawk on the ARM64 builds; ripgrep and fd have ARM64 artifacts) the package ships WITHOUT that entry — run `winuxcmd wpm install <name>` once after installing to add it. The pre-install list and its recorded exclusions live in `scripts/release/preinstall.json`.

`niubash-skill-v<version>.zip` is the AI agent skill bundle (SKILL.md + references, WinuxCmd-skill layout): unpack it into an agent skills directory, or let the shell do it — `niu skill install` embeds the same content.

Linux (x86_64, aarch64; glibc): portable tarballs with the `niu` binary, README, and LICENSE — Unix builds bundle nothing, native system tools are used. Untar anywhere and run `./niu`.

macOS (aarch64, x86_64): portable tarballs with the `niu` binary, README, and LICENSE. Untar anywhere and run `./niu`.

Every artifact was smoke-verified on the build OS of the job that produced it, before upload: `niu -c 'echo ok'`, `printf 'a\nb\n' | niu -c 'sort | head -1'`, an offline `NIU_PLUGIN_SPEC=<empty> niu plugin sync --bootstrap` (exit 0, no output, no network), and a `niu --version` check against this tag and the engine revision.

Integrity (niubash#311): `SHA256SUMS` lists the SHA-256 of every shipped artifact, and each Windows installer has a `.sha256` sidecar beside it. `niu --self-update` verifies the installer against the sidecar before running it and aborts rather than execute anything it cannot verify. The same digests feed the winget manifest `InstallerSha256`.

## Licenses & Source

Niubash itself is MIT (`LICENSE` in this repository and at the root of every package). The Windows packages bundle third-party payloads pre-installed from `scripts/release/preinstall.json`; each component ships its canonical license text under `licenses\<component>\` in the package tree, and the installer wizard surfaces niubash's own license at install time:

- **gawk** — `GPL-3.0-or-later`; upstream

# Niubash — native Bash for Windows (Git Bash alternative) > **Real Bash, native on Windows, Linux, and macOS.** No WSL. No VM. No `/mnt/c`. No cmdlet dialect. One binary: the shell your fingers already know — and the one your AI agent actually speaks.
[English](README.md) · [中文](README-zh.md) Docs & downloads: [unixwin.dev](https://unixwin.dev) [![niubash CI](https://github.com/unixwin/niubash/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/unixwin/niubash/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/unixwin/niubash)](https://github.com/unixwin/niubash/releases) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%20%7C%20Linux%20%7C%20macOS%20%7C%20Android-blue)](https://github.com/unixwin/niubash) [![Rust](https://img.shields.io/badge/rust-1.95%2B-orange)](https://github.com/unixwin/niubash) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/unixwin/niubash)](https://github.com/unixwin/niubash/stargazers)
**[Install](#quick-start) · [Niubash vs Git Bash](#niubash-vs-git-bash) · [Why not Git Bash / MSYS2 / Cygwin](#why-not-git-bash--msys2--cygwin) · [AI agents](#built-for-ai-agents) · [Compatibility](#compatibility--testing) · [Performance](#performance) · [Limitations](#known-limitations-stated-plainly)** **niubash** is a Bash-compatible shell implemented natively in Rust — a Git Bash alternative. On Windows, the flagship platform, one `niu.exe` carries the whole stack: - the [rubash](https://github.com/unixwin/rubash) language engine — GNU Bash 5.3 semantics with no emulation layer; - real Unix commands from [WinuxCmd](https://github.com/unixwin/winuxcmd), native builds designed for shell use; - a git-aware prompt and a permission-modeled plugin system; - git itself: [niu-git](https://github.com/unixwin/niu-git) is the real git-for-windows C source built with MSVC, so the `git` on PATH *is* the git binary — no MSYS runtime, no launcher hop, no bundled perl. Git's shell-script parts (hooks, `git bisect`, `git mergetool`) run on niubash's own `sh`. Agents launched from a niu session inherit it as their shell through `SHELL`; [Coding agents on Windows](docs/src/agents.md) documents, agent by agent, which shell each one runs and how to point the rest at niu. The Linux and macOS builds are portable `niu` binaries that use your system's own tools. niu is not MSYS2, Cygwin, Git Bash, or WSL — there is no POSIX emulation layer and no path-conversion heuristics. It is a from-scratch replacement for Git Bash: a native Windows binary. The full per-platform contract, including the honest status of every target, lives in [platform-support.md](docs/src/platform-support.md).

*The same commands, two outcomes — Git Bash's MSYS layer vs niu, side by side. Tap the image for the animated version (`assets/demo-gitbash.gif`).* ## Quick start All downloads start at [unixwin.dev](https://unixwin.dev). Latest release: **v1.5.0** (2026-11-03; the [releases page](https://github.com/unixwin/niubash/releases) always carries the newest build). Windows via winget (**1.5.0**): ```powershell winget install --id Unixwin.Niubash ``` Windows via Scoop (**1.5.0**, portable zip, `niu` shimmed onto PATH; `scoop update niubash` follows releases): the Extras-bucket submission ([ScoopInstaller/Extras#19334](https://github.com/ScoopInstaller/Extras/pull/19334)) is in review — once it merges, `scoop bucket add extras` then `scoop install niubash`. Until then, install from the in-repo reference manifest: ```powershell scoop install https://raw.githubusercontent.com/unixwin/niubash/master/installer/scoop/niubash.json ``` Windows via installer: grab `niubash-v*-win-*-setup.exe` from [Releases](https://github.com/unixwin/niubash/releases) and run it — no admin rights; PATH and a Windows Terminal profile are set up for you. Prefer portable? Take the `.tar.gz` (`tar -xf niubash-v*-win-x64.tar.gz`, built into Windows 10+) — it restores the bundled git/awk payload's hardlinks on unpack, so the extracted tree stays as small as a `wpm` install. The `.7z` is the smallest download (solid compression), but it stores the duplicated payload content rather than links, so the extracted tree is larger. The `.zip` stays only for tooling that speaks nothing but zip: it cannot represent hardlinks, so the payload is stored duplicated and the archive is much larger. Linux via apt (x86_64, aarch64; Ubuntu 22.04+, Debian 12+): ```sh curl -fsSL https://unixwin.github.io/apt/KEY.gpg | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/niubash-archive-keyring.gpg echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/niubash-archive-keyring.gpg] https://unixwin.github.io/apt stable main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/niubash.list sudo apt update && sudo apt install niubash ``` The archive follows releases automatically (picked up within hours of a release; `gh workflow run build-apt -R unixwin/apt` triggers the pickup immediately). It installs `/usr/bin/niu` only — your system bash and coreutils stay untouched. Linux (x86_64, aarch64; glibc 2.35+) and macOS (aarch64, x86_64): take the portable tarball, untar, run: ```sh tar -xzf niubash-v*-linux-x86_64.tar.gz && niubash-v*-linux-x86_64/niu ``` Android (aarch64, armv7): release `.zip` assets ship since v1.4.3 and run on real devices (Termux) — see [Platforms](#platforms) for the honest per-platform status. From source (Rust 1.95+): `git clone https://github.com/unixwin/niubash.git && cd niubash && cargo build --release` On Windows, configuration is ONE file, `~/.niubashrc`, in plain Bash syntax — the only startup file niu reads there. Login shells on Linux/macOS also read the GNU profile chain (`/etc/profile`, then the first of `~/.bash_profile` → `~/.bash_login` → `~/.profile`), exactly as GNU bash does; `~/.bashrc` is never sourced directly (run `niu plugin migrate-rc --diff` to see exactly what is worth carrying over) — start with [Getting started](docs/src/getting-started.md). ### First run, verified ```console $ niu --version Niubash 1.5.0 — bash-compatible shell for Windows, Linux, macOS, and Android rubash git 29bbf52481c3 winuxcmd WinuxCmd 1.2.1 $ niu -c 'echo $BASH_VERSION' 5.3.20(1)-release ``` `--version` names the exact engine and command-layer builds the binary carries, so "which build am I talking to" always has an answer on record — the property an agent's logs depend on ([rubash#488](https://github.com/unixwin/rubash/issues/488)). ## Why not Git Bash / MSYS2 / Cygwin **Git Bash** calls itself, verbatim, "a BASH emulation used to run Git from the command line" — an emulation built to run Git. The costs are structural. Console device redirects such as `echo >/dev/tty` fail outright with `Invalid argument` in its MSYS layer, where niubash matches GNU. Its bundled bash is on the 5.2 line, so bash 5.3's `${ cmd; }` nofork substitution does not exist. Its prompt runs `__git_ps1` — a git process — on every draw. niu's git segment asks your own git at most once per prompt pass (one bounded `status --porcelain=v2 --branch` query, 2 s timeout), and repaints within the pass reuse that result instead of spawning again (measured steady state inside a repository: 1.0 spawn per pass, p50 26 ms per pass; Windows, same machine). And a real Git for Windows install is ≈440 MB plus a 20 MB simulation DLL, versus niu at ≈16 MB with zero DLLs (project-measured, as of 2026-10-25). **MSYS2**'s own documentation concedes that arguments resembling Unix paths are automatically rewritten before being passed to native programs — and that the rewriting "isn't perfect," hitting arguments that aren't paths, or path lists that aren't. niubash keeps translation deliberately narrow: quoted arguments are translated exactly like unquoted ones when they spell a path (`'/c/Windows'` reaches a native child as `C:\Windows`, while a `name=value` form such as `--prefix=/c/x` is left alone), and the only device translation is the exact token `/dev/null` → `nul`; every overreach ever found became a public issue and a pinned regression test. **Cygwin** states on its own site that its core is a DLL providing POSIX API functionality, and that applications must be rebuilt from source to run in its world. The simulation layer is its official definition. niubash is a native build: no simulation DLL. ## Niubash vs Git Bash | | **Niubash** | **Git Bash** | | --- | --- | --- | | Engine | Bash semantics reimplemented natively in Rust ([rubash](https://github.com/unixwin/rubash)); no emulation layer | GNU Bash ported onto the MSYS2 POSIX emulation runtime | | Bash language level | **GNU Bash 5.3** semantics — including 5.3-only syntax such as no-fork command substitution `${ cmd; }` ([rubash#195](https://github.com/unixwin/rubash/issues/195)) | GNU Bash **5.2** (the version Git for Windows bundles) | | Path handling | Windows paths are the native representation; argument translation is a deterministic, documented contract — path-shaped arguments are translated whether quoted or not, `name=value` forms are left alone, no guessing | Heuristic path conversion of arguments, with `MSYS_NO_PATHCONV` as the documented opt-out | | `git` | Real git-for-windows C source built with MSVC ([niu-git](https://github.com/unixwin/niu-git)) — the binary itself; no MSYS runtime, no launcher hop | `git` launched through the MSYS runtime | | Prompt git segment | Your own git, at most once per prompt pass (bounded porcelain query); repaints reuse the result | Runs `__git_ps1` — spawns git on every prompt | | Subshells | In-process — `( )` and `$( )` create no processes | `fork()` emulation | | Console devices | `/dev/tty` redirects behave like GNU — the engine splits `CON` into `CONIN$`/`CONOUT$` (see [Quick answers](#quick-answers)) | Console device redirects fail outright in the MSYS layer | | Install footprint | ≈16 MB, zero DLLs | ≈440 MB + 20 MB `msys-2.0.dll` (project-measured, real installs, as of 2026-10-25) | The long version — including same-command-line side-by-sides of what actually reaches a native process — is [Why niubash](docs/src/why-niubash.md). ## The command layer: built for a shell The bundled commands are **WinuxCmd**: 176 commands plus the 2 internal helpers `wpm` and `[` — 178 applets, 1,924 options — native Windows builds, evolved in lockstep with this shell ([repo](https://github.com/unixwin/winuxcmd)); path forms, argument passing, and shell interplay are designed against shell semantics. The obvious alternative, Microsoft's own coreutils package, is an upstream uutils build *packaged* for PowerShell/CMD (its repo describes itself as "Installer & Packaging", and the package is in preview). Its README states its own limits: **no `/dev/null`**, **no POSIX signals**, `kill` and `timeout` not shipped, and twenty-plus commands — `chmod`, `chown`, `id`, `tty`, `mkfifo`, `nohup`, `stty`, … — dropped wholesale as "POSIX-only concepts". A command layer for a shell cannot start by discarding the concepts a shell lives on. ## And the "lightweight replacement" shells The new Rust shells sell lightness. Of the peers, hush is a Lua-based language that never claimed to replace bash, and Oils/OSH calls itself an "upgrade path from bash", not a drop-in. **brush** claims the drop-in: "Run it as your everyday shell", "Production-ready for most use cases". Measured with a 306-case differential corpus (byte-compared against GNU Bash 5.3.20): its shipped v0.4.0 scores 181/306, and a source build of its latest master commit re-measures at 183/306 — the same failure profile — against rubash's 304/306 on the same ruler. The misses are foundation mechanisms, not edge cases: an alias timing model reversed from GNU's (6 substantive divergences in 20 probes), `printf x y` looping forever and hanging the script in the release (fixed on master), `wait $!` unimplemented in scripts, globstar that does not recurse while listed as "Fully Supported", and nameref `unset` reporting "not yet implemented" — which a real oh-my-bash load trips over. Its Windows support is self-described "Preview", and v0.4.0 ships no Windows binary at all. Lightweight is no excuse for missing limbs. Complete bash semantics re-implemented path by path without fork, plus cross-platform itself, is what 445,221 net lines (rubash 380,217 + niubash 65,004; tests excluded, the code-size caliber of the rubash README, measured 2026-11-20) buys. An implementation that misses these mechanisms can be neither a bash replacement nor a reliable login shell. ## Built for AI agents Models are trained on Bash; on a Windows machine their commands deserve a shell that executes them the way they were written. - **Agents inherit niu as their shell.** Anything launched from a niu session gets it through `SHELL`, and [Coding agents on Windows](docs/src/agents.md) documents, agent by agent, which shell each one runs and how to point the rest at niu. - **`--ec`: stop quoting commands, base64 them instead.** An agent's command passes through several hosts before it reaches the shell — and every one of them can break nested quotes, expand `$`, or eat backslashes. niu accepts the whole command as one base64 string, so there is simply nothing left to escape: ```console # the command you want to run: # git log -1 --format="commit %h on %cd" --date="format:%Y-%m-%d" # base64 it — one line in any language — and hand niu the string: $ niu --ec Z2l0IGxvZyAtMSAtLWZvcm1hdD0iY29tbWl0ICVoIG9uICVjZCIgLS1kYXRlPSJmb3JtYXQ6JVktJW0tJWQi commit 58e10d1 on 2026-11-02 ``` Same output as typing the command by hand — but the agent never wrote a single quote. (Captured in the niubash checkout, 2026-11-04.) PowerShell users already know this shape: `-EncodedCommand`, spelled the same way and case-insensitive (`--ec` is the short alias). The decoder accepts wrapped lines, missing padding, and an optional `v1:` prefix that guards the payload through Git-Bash-style layers. Full cookbook for Python / Node / Rust / PowerShell — encoders, the failure modes this removes, payload limits — in [Coding agents on Windows](docs/src/agents.md). **Wiring a tool to niu?** The integration is a one-line change where the command line gets built — wherever the code assembles `["-c", cmd]`, it assembles `["--ec", b64]` instead: ```rust use base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD as B64; use base64::Engine as _; // before — the command travels as raw argv; any layer that re-quotes, // expands, or truncates it breaks the call c.args(["-c", command]); // after — base64 in, the command bytes reach niu verbatim c.args(["--ec", &B64.encode(command.as_bytes())]); ``` The swap is the same shape in every host language. Shell flags keep working in front of the payload: `niu -eu -o pipefail --ec ` runs the decoded command under `errexit` and `pipefail`. - **Real agent usage came first.** OpenCode users run `niu.exe` as their agent's shell and drove the environment-driven init work ([#82](https://github.com/unixwin/niubash/issues/82)); a Hermes integration failure — literal quotes leaking into external-command arguments — was filed and fixed ([#124](https://github.com/unixwin/niubash/issues/124)); and after three false-baseline incidents in a single day, `--version` now carries build metadata, so an agent can always tell exactly which build it is talking to ([rubash#488](https://github.com/unixwin/rubash/issues/488) — shown under [First run, verified](#first-run-verified) above). - **Deterministic non-interactive behavior.** `niu -c` and script runs are quiet and stable: no banners, stable stdout/stderr, exact exit-code propagation — the properties an agent's tool loop depends on. - **No path roulette.** There is no `MSYS_NO_PATHCONV` to remember and no heuristic rewriting arguments behind the child's back — `/flags` stay `/flags`, and path-shaped operands are translated by one documented contract ([windows-path-contract.md](docs/src/windows-path-contract.md)). - **An agent skill ships with every release**: the `niubash-skill-v*.zip` asset on the [Releases](https://github.com/unixwin/niubash/releases) page packages the shell's documented behavior for agent consumption ([#188](https://github.com/unixwin/niubash/issues/188)), and the engine repo carries its own disclosure in `SKILL.md` (including the platform identity semantics). The casualty list that motivates this — real agent failures on PowerShell and emulation shells, with receipts — is in [Why niubash](docs/src/why-niubash.md#agent-casualties-with-receipts). ## Compatibility & testing niu's language semantics are the rubash engine's, and they are gated mechanically, not anecdotally: - **GNU's own 83-suite upstream corpus is the yardstick.** The engine's ledger (2026-10-12 full re-run): 62 suites byte-identical stdout on Windows, 20 more differing only on environment-attributed lines, and the one nameref residual proven to be GNU's own reap-timing race — the full ledger lives in the [rubash README](https://github.com/unixwin/rubash#compatibility-at-a-glance), and rubash CI replays the corpus on Linux on every push. - **An independent 246-case differential suite** against a locally built GNU Bash 5.3.20: **244/246 byte-identical** on current master (222/246 at the first audit, 2026-10-22). - **A 306-case differential corpus**: rubash scores **304/306** (see the peer measurements above). - **Every fixed issue lands with a regression test** named for the issue, asserting the GNU behavior — on both the engine and the host side (`tests/compat.rs`, `tests/host_contract.rs`, and the per-capability fixtures in the [compatibility matrix](docs/src/rubash-bash-compat-matrix.md)). - **Releases are smoke-gated and budget-gated**: no artifact ships unless it runs on its own OS and stays inside the per-asset timing budgets (see [Receipts](#receipts)). As of 2026-11-03 the trackers carry the receipts: rubash 1,680 issues filed / 1,654 closed; niubash 449 filed / 425 closed. ## Receipts Each claim below links to the artifact that produced it: a committed log, a baseline file, a CI gate. **6,336 real-world shell assets, harvested and replayed one by one.** The pipeline pulls shell scripts, frameworks, themes, and dotfiles from GitHub and sources each one under niu, recording a per-asset verdict: 4,891 OK, 350 slow, 224 that GNU Bash also fails, 101 hangs, 698 that never fetched — plus 72 in the small buckets: 54 syntax forms rubash still rejects where GNU accepts, 17 early exits, 1 error storm. The full log is committed ([eco-harvest.py](scripts/harvest/eco-harvest.py), [eco-test.py](scripts/harvest/eco-test.py), snapshot [wt92-local-20261005](scripts/harvest/snapshots/wt92-local-20261005/)). **Framework assets are sourced and timed.** The timing baseline loads 437 real oh-my-bash and bash-it assets (166 themes plus plugins, completions, aliases) and measures three phases per asset (source, first prompt, re-render) as a median of three runs. That includes the nvm assets of both frameworks, and real users' dotfiles that load nvm.sh go through the same harness with per-phase timings on record ([baseline](scripts/perf/baselines/asset-timing-baseline.json), [snapshot](scripts/harvest/snapshots/wt92-local-20261005/)). **A release cannot ship slow.** Every asset in [budgets.json](scripts/perf/budgets.json) carries a measured budget (healthy themes re-render in 11–35 ms and the budget line is 120 ms on the Windows reference baseline; 5× over budget is a hard fail). The [release pipeline](.github/workflows/release.yml) runs the `perfbudget` gate and fails the release on a breach; a nightly run watches the trend. ## Performance Every number below comes from one published protocol — the 2026-10-25 baseline (PERF-BASELINE-2026-10-25, in the public [shellbench](https://github.com/unixwin/shellbench) repo): release builds, Linux, against a self-built GNU Bash 5.3.20. **The honest headline.** The embedded rubash engine pays a roughly uniform **~3× floor tax** on interpreter-bound micro-work (arithmetic, function calls, assignment, read loops at 2.8–3.2× per-op). Beating GNU across the full table is the stated goal — the standing hard target of the post-1.5.0 programme; the current status is published, not hidden. Where the cost is process creation, the model inverts: pipeline stages and command substitution run in-process, at **0.05×** (pipe) and **0.11×** (command-substitution loop) of GNU's time. **Startup — the one quotable set.** `-c 'true'`, p50 of 50 interleaved samples, release builds, Linux: **niu 3.96 ms, rubash 3.43 ms, GNU Bash 5.3.20 2.59 ms**. No Windows startup figures are quoted until re-measured on real Windows hardware under the same protocol. **Windows process economics.** A console-less session used to pay a hidden-console allocation on *every* external spawn. The fix is one hidden console per session — pre-allocated windowless on Windows 11 24H2+/Server 2025, adopted from the first `CREATE_NO_WINDOW` child elsewhere — pinned by 14 regression tests (design in [#462](https://github.com/unixwin/niubash/issues/462), landed engine-side in [rubash#913](https://github.com/unixwin/rubash/pull/913)). And `$(tput …)` terminal queries are answered in-process for admitted TERM×capability shapes, byte-equal to GNU ncurses on a 269-row differential matrix, with zero spawns ([rubash#884](https://github.com/unixwin/rubash/pull/884)). **Loop scripts — one Windows machine, measured.** Same-machine Windows measurement (niubash 1.4.4): a 50-iteration loop over a `sed|grep|awk` pipeline — 150 external command launches in total — takes 1.502s in niubash and 27.256s in Git Bash, roughly 18×. The gap is not in the commands; it is Windows process-startup cost: no fork, no POSIX emulation layer, a startup surface more than an order of magnitude smaller. Original record: [niubash #567](https://github.com/unixwin/niubash/issues/567). **Android, stated plainly.** An on-device Android baseline exists ([#352](https://github.com/unixwin/niubash/issues/352)); its engine-side root causes were found and closed (rubash#607–#609), fork-bound workloads already ran faster there, and a post-fix on-device re-measure is still owed — we say so instead of quoting the stale pre-fix numbers. ## Platforms | Platform | Status | Ships as | |---|---|---| | Windows x64 / ARM64 | Released; smoke-gated every release | installer `.exe` + portable `.tar.gz`/`.7z`/`.zip`, Unix commands bundled | | Linux x86_64 / aarch64 (glibc 2.35+) | Released; smoke-gated every release | apt repo (`stable`), portable `.tar.gz`, uses system tools | | macOS aarch64 / x86_64 | Released; smoke-gated every release | portable `.tar.gz`, uses system tools | | Android aarch64 / armv7 | Shipped since v1.4.3; runs on real devices (Termux), release smoke gate not yet wired in CI | NDK-linked `.zip` release asset | | OpenHarmony (`aarch64-unknown-linux-ohos`) | CI check only, no release | kept compiling by CI, never run on a device | "Smoke-gated" means the artifact is built, then run on its own OS against four checks (`--version`, `-c` execution, a pipeline through native coreutils, the offline plugin stack) before upload — the gate lives in `release.yml` ("no smoke, no artifact": Linux legs run it natively on `ubuntu-22.04`/`ubuntu-22.04-arm`, the macOS x86_64 leg under Rosetta 2), and the release as a whole also blocks on the golden user journey and the per-asset timing budget gates. OpenHarmony has not passed that gate (compile-checked only, never run on a device). Android ships release `.zip` assets since v1.4.3 and runs on real devices (Termux aarch64/armv7, daily-driven with on-device benchmark baselines); what it lacks is the automated per-release smoke leg in CI, which is wired for Windows/Linux/macOS only. The per-platform contract and the full status matrix live in [platform-support.md](docs/src/platform-support.md). ## Quick answers - **Does niu require WSL?** No. niu is a native build on every platform it ships for: on Windows there is no Linux VM, no emulation layer, no `/mnt/c`. - **What platforms does niu run on?** Released builds cover Windows (x64, ARM64), Linux (x86_64, aarch64; glibc 2.35+), macOS (aarch64, x86_64), and Android (aarch64, armv7; `.zip` assets since v1.4.3, running on real devices). OpenHarmony (aarch64) builds in CI and has no release yet. - **Does niu run real Bash scripts?** Yes. The rubash engine is gated on GNU Bash's own upstream test suites; the record lives in the [compatibility matrix](docs/src/rubash-bash-compat-matrix.md). - **Beyond Git Bash compatibility.** Console device redirects work where even Git Bash fails: `echo >/dev/tty`, `exec 3<>/dev/tty`, and `test -e /dev/tty` all behave like GNU — the engine maps `/dev/tty` to the console and splits `CON` into its `CONIN$`/`CONOUT$` halves instead of hitting Windows' device-open restrictions (`FILE_APPEND_DATA` and read-write opens are rejected on `CON`). This is what keeps `git`/`ssh` askpass prompts working. (Engine trail: [rubash#1312](https://github.com/unixwin/rubash/issues/1312), [rubash#1314](https://github.com/unixwin/rubash/issues/1314), [niubash#519](https://github.com/unixwin/niubash/issues/519).) - **Can I install niu on Android or HarmonyOS today?** Android yes: release `.zip` assets ship since v1.4.3 and run on real devices (Termux aarch64/armv7). HarmonyOS not yet: it compiles in CI but has no installable artifact. - **Which git does niu use — and how do I use niu's git from pwsh or an IDE?** The bundled niugit wins inside niu by default (the bundled directories are injected ahead of your `PATH` at startup); set `NIU_USER_PATH_FIRST=1` to let your own `PATH` order — your git included — win instead. Every program outside niu can resolve the bundled niugit through the install's single `PATH` entry directory, `\winuxcmd\bin` — never `usr\bin`. Details and recipes: [Using Git](docs/src/using-git.md) ([#1049](https://github.com/unixwin/niubash/issues/1049), [#1050](https://github.com/unixwin/niubash/issues/1050)). - **Migrating a Git Bash script — why does `cmd //c` sit at a prompt?** `//` is MSYS's own escape for its argument rewriting, which niu does not have: the doubled slash reaches cmd.exe verbatim, `//c` is not a switch cmd knows, and cmd opens an interactive session — a hang, not an error. Use `cmd /c`, the spelling MSYS made fragile; under niu it works as written ([path contract](docs/src/windows-path-contract.md#shell-namespace-ownership)). ## Known limitations, stated plainly - **The installer is not code-signed yet.** Windows SmartScreen will warn on first run ([#511](https://github.com/unixwin/niubash/issues/511) — a SignPath signing route is set up; its production release-signing approval is still pending). Verify downloads against the published SHA-256 sums in the meantime. - **Interpreter speed is a measured, published gap** (see [Performance](#performance)) — not a hidden one. Process-bound workloads already lead; interpreter-bound micro-work is the post-1.5.0 programme's hard target. ## Documentation [Docs site](https://unixwin.github.io/niubash/) · [Why niubash](docs/src/why-niubash.md) (the long version, with the agent casualties) · [Platform support](docs/src/platform-support.md) · [Bash compatibility matrix](docs/src/rubash-bash-compat-matrix.md) · [Roadmap](docs/src/niubash-roadmap.md) On the engine side, 1.5.0 lands the **embeddable engine API** ([rubash#595](https://github.com/unixwin/rubash/issues/595)) and a **native script debugger** — `rubash --debug` for humans and `--dap` for editors, two front ends over one debug session ([rubash#497](https://github.com/unixwin/rubash/issues/497)). --- If niu saved you a Linux VM, a mangled quote, or an argument PowerShell ate, [star the repo](https://github.com/unixwin/niubash) and tell a developer. ★ ## Code size The net caliber (non-blank lines, tests excluded) is shared with rubash and maintained in [rubash's docs/code-size.md](https://github.com/unixwin/rubash/blob/master/docs/code-size.md): niubash nets 65,004 lines at the last joint measurement (2026-11-20). The table below is the gross caliber — [tokei](https://github.com/XAMPPRocky/tokei) over the whole tree, tests included, refreshed weekly by the readme-stats workflow. | Language | Files | Code lines | |---|---:|---:| | Rust | 227 | 115,062 | | JSON | 24 | 65,372 | | Python | 46 | 20,947 | | TOML | 184 | 9,449 | | Shell | 58 | 2,558 | | PowerShell | 10 | 1,252 | | C | 1 | 352 | | SVG | 22 | 77 | | BASH | 12 | 69 | | JavaScript | 1 | 66 | | Other | 2 | 63 | | **Total** | **587** | **215,267** | ## Maintainers | Maintainer | Role | |---|---| | [@caomengxuan666](https://github.com/caomengxuan666) | Creator and core maintainer | | [@arookieofc](https://github.com/arookieofc) | Core maintainer | Everyone who has landed code is listed under [Contributors](#contributors). ## Contributors [![All Contributors](https://img.shields.io/badge/all_contributors-13-orange.svg?style=flat-square)](#contributors) Thanks to everyone building niubash — issues, fixes, plugins, adapted work, and engine work upstream ([emoji key](https://allcontributors.org/docs/en/emoji-key)):

# Niubash — 原生 Windows Bash（Git Bash alternative） > **真·Bash，Windows、Linux、macOS 原生构建。** 不用 WSL，不开虚拟机，没有 `/mnt/c`，没有 cmdlet 方言。一个二进制：你手指肌肉记得的那个 shell，也是你 AI agent 天生会说的那个 shell。
[English](README.md) · [中文](README-zh.md) 文档与下载：[unixwin.dev](https://unixwin.dev) [![niubash CI](https://github.com/unixwin/niubash/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/unixwin/niubash/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/unixwin/niubash)](https://github.com/unixwin/niubash/releases) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%20%7C%20Linux%20%7C%20macOS%20%7C%20Android-blue)](https://github.com/unixwin/niubash) [![Rust](https://img.shields.io/badge/rust-1.95%2B-orange)](https://github.com/unixwin/niubash) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/unixwin/niubash)](https://github.com/unixwin/niubash/stargazers)
**[安装](#快速开始) · [Niubash vs Git Bash](#niubash-vs-git-bash) · [为什么不用 Git Bash / MSYS2 / Cygwin](#为什么不用-git-bash--msys2--cygwin) · [AI agent](#为-ai-agent-而建) · [兼容性与测试](#兼容性与测试) · [性能](#性能) · [已知限制](#已知限制明说)** **niubash** 是用 Rust 原生实现的 Bash 兼容 shell（Git Bash alternative）。在旗舰平台 Windows 上，一个 `niu.exe` 装下整个栈： - [rubash](https://github.com/unixwin/rubash) 语言引擎——GNU Bash 5.3 语义，无模拟层； - 来自 [WinuxCmd](https://github.com/unixwin/winuxcmd) 的真 Unix 命令，为 shell 使用设计的原生构建； - 带 git 状态的 prompt，与带权限模型的插件系统； - 还有 git 本体：[niu-git](https://github.com/unixwin/niu-git) 是用 MSVC 构建的 git-for-windows 真 C 源码，PATH 上的 `git` 就是 git 本身——没有 MSYS 运行时，没有启动器跳板，不带 perl。git 的 shell 脚本部分（hooks、`git bisect`、`git mergetool`）跑在 niubash 自己的 `sh` 上。 从 niu 会话启动的 agent 会经 `SHELL` 继承它作为 shell；哪些 agent 跑什么 shell、怎么把其余的指过来，[Coding agents on Windows](docs/src/agents.md) 逐个写明。Linux 与 macOS 构建是便携 `niu` 二进制，直接用系统自带的工具。 niu 不是 MSYS2、Cygwin、Git Bash，也不是 WSL——没有 POSIX 模拟层，也没有启发式的路径转换。它是 Git Bash 的 from-scratch replacement：原生 Windows 二进制。每个平台的完整契约（包括每个目标的诚实状态）见 [platform-support.md](docs/src/platform-support.md)。

*同一组命令，两种下场——Git Bash 的 MSYS 层对比 niu，并排实录。点图片看动图版（`assets/demo-gitbash.gif`）。* ## 快速开始 下载统一从 [unixwin.dev](https://unixwin.dev) 进入。最新版本：**v1.5.0**（2026-11-03；最新构建始终在 [Releases](https://github.com/unixwin/niubash/releases) 页）。 Windows（winget，**1.5.0**）： ```powershell winget install --id Unixwin.Niubash ``` Windows（Scoop，**1.5.0**，便携 zip，`niu` 由 scoop shim 上 PATH；`scoop update niubash` 跟随发行版）：Extras 仓库的提交（[ScoopInstaller/Extras#19334](https://github.com/ScoopInstaller/Extras/pull/19334)）正在审核，合并后即可 `scoop bucket add extras` 再 `scoop install niubash`。合并前可直接用仓内参考 manifest 安装： ```powershell scoop install https://raw.githubusercontent.com/unixwin/niubash/master/installer/scoop/niubash.json ``` Windows（安装器）：去 [Releases](https://github.com/unixwin/niubash/releases) 下载 `niubash-v*-win-*-setup.exe` 双击——不要管理员权限，PATH 和 Windows Terminal 配置自动配好。要便携版就拿 `.tar.gz`（`tar -xf niubash-v*-win-x64.tar.gz`，Windows 10+ 自带）——解包时还原捆绑 git/awk 载荷的硬链接，解出来的目录和 `wpm` 安装一样小。`.7z` 下载最小（solid 压缩），但它存的是重复载荷内容而非链接，解出来体积更大。`.zip` 只留给除 zip 什么都不认的工具链：它存不了硬链接，载荷被重复存放，包大得多。 Linux（apt，x86_64 / aarch64；Ubuntu 22.04+、Debian 12+）： ```sh curl -fsSL https://unixwin.github.io/apt/KEY.gpg | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/niubash-archive-keyring.gpg echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/niubash-archive-keyring.gpg] https://unixwin.github.io/apt stable main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/niubash.list sudo apt update && sudo apt install niubash ``` 归档自动跟随发布（发布后数小时内收录；`gh workflow run build-apt -R unixwin/apt` 可立即触发）。只装 `/usr/bin/niu`，不动系统 bash 和 coreutils。 Linux（x86_64、aarch64；glibc 2.35+）与 macOS（aarch64、x86_64）：拿便携 tarball，解包即跑： ```sh tar -xzf niubash-v*-linux-x86_64.tar.gz && niubash-v*-linux-x86_64/niu ``` Android（aarch64、armv7）：v1.4.3 起 release 自带 `.zip`，真机（Termux）可运行——各平台的诚实状态见[平台支持](#平台支持)。 源码构建（Rust 1.95+）： `git clone https://github.com/unixwin/niubash.git && cd niubash && cargo build --release` 配置只有一个文件：`~/.niubashrc`，纯 Bash 语法——它是 niu 在 Windows 上唯一读取的启动文件。Linux/macOS 的登录 shell 额外读 GNU profile 链（`/etc/profile`，然后 `~/.bash_profile` → `~/.bash_login` → `~/.profile` 取第一个存在的），与 GNU bash 完全一致；`~/.bashrc` 永不被直接 source（`niu plugin migrate-rc --diff` 会告诉你哪些东西值得搬过来）——从[快速上手](docs/src/getting-started.md)开始。 ### 首跑实测 ```console $ niu --version Niubash 1.5.0 — bash-compatible shell for Windows, Linux, macOS, and Android rubash git 29bbf52481c3 winuxcmd WinuxCmd 1.2.1 $ niu -c 'echo $BASH_VERSION' 5.3.20(1)-release ``` `--version` 直接报出这个二进制携带的引擎与命令层的确切构建——"我在跟哪个构建说话"永远有案可查，这正是 agent 日志依赖的性质（[rubash#488](https://github.com/unixwin/rubash/issues/488)）。 ## 为什么不用 Git Bash / MSYS2 / Cygwin **Git Bash** 官网自称是「a BASH emulation used to run Git from the command line」——为跑 Git 而设的模拟。代价是结构性的：`echo >/dev/tty` 等控制台设备重定向在它的 MSYS 层直接 `Invalid argument` 失败，niubash 与 GNU 一致；它捆绑的 bash 停在 5.2 系，5.3 的 `${ cmd; }` 无 fork 命令替换不存在；它的提示符每一帧都跑 `__git_ps1`——一个 git 进程；niu 的 git 段每遍至多问一次你自己的 git——一条有界的 `status --porcelain=v2 --branch` 查询（2 秒超时）——同遍重绘复用结果、不再重复 spawn（仓内稳态实测：1.0 次 spawn/遍、p50 26 ms/遍；Windows 同机口径）；真实安装的 Git for Windows 约 440 MB 外加 20 MB 模拟 DLL，niu 约 16 MB、零 DLL（项目自测口径，截至 2026-10-25）。 **MSYS2** 的官方文档自承：参数只要像 Unix 路径，传给原生程序前就会被自动改写，而且「并不完美」——会命中根本不是路径的参数、或不是路径列表的参数。niubash 的翻译面刻意收窄：引号参数与不带引号的参数一样，只要拼出路径就会被翻译（`'/c/Windows'` 到原生子进程是 `C:\Windows`，而 `--prefix=/c/x` 这样的 `name=value` 形式原样保留），唯一设备翻译是精确 token `/dev/null` → `nul`；每次被发现的过度翻译都立公开 issue 并固化回归。 **Cygwin** 官网自承其核心是一个提供 POSIX API 功能的 DLL，并明说应用必须从源码重编才能在它的世界里运行。模拟层是它的官方定义。niubash 是原生构建，没有模拟 DLL。 ## Niubash vs Git Bash | | **Niubash** | **Git Bash** | | --- | --- | --- | | 引擎 | Rust 原生重实现的 bash 语义（[rubash](https://github.com/unixwin/rubash)）；无模拟层 | GNU Bash 移植到 MSYS2 POSIX 模拟运行时之上 | | Bash 语言层级 | **GNU Bash 5.3** 语义——含 5.3 独有的无 fork 命令替换 `${ cmd; }`（[rubash#195](https://github.com/unixwin/rubash/issues/195)） | GNU Bash **5.2**（Git for Windows 捆绑版本） | | 路径处理 | Windows 路径即原生表示；参数翻译是确定性的成文契约——无论是否带引号，路径形参数都会翻译，`name=value` 形式原样保留，不靠猜 | 对参数的启发式路径转换，官方逃生舱是 `MSYS_NO_PATHCONV` | | `git` | 用 MSVC 构建的 git-for-windows 真 C 源码（[niu-git](https://github.com/unixwin/niu-git)）——就是二进制本体；无 MSYS 运行时、无启动器跳板 | 经 MSYS 运行时启动的 `git` | | 提示符 git 段 | 你自己的 git，每遍至多一次（有界 porcelain 查询）；同遍重绘复用结果 | 每个提示符都跑 `__git_ps1`——spawn 一个 git 进程 | | 子壳 | 进程内——`( )` 与 `$( )` 不创建进程 | `fork()` 模拟 | | 控制台设备 | `/dev/tty` 重定向与 GNU 一致——引擎把 `CON` 拆为 `CONIN$`/`CONOUT$`（见[快答](#快答)） | 控制台设备重定向在 MSYS 层直接失败 | | 安装体积 | ≈16 MB，零 DLL | ≈440 MB + 20 MB `msys-2.0.dll`（项目自测口径，真实安装，截至 2026-10-25） | 长版论据——包括同一命令行下「到底有什么抵达了原生进程」的并排对照——在 [Why niubash](docs/src/why-niubash.md)。 ## 命令层：为 shell 而造 捆绑的命令是 **WinuxCmd**：176 个命令外加 `wpm`、`[` 两个内部辅助——共 178 个 applet、1,924 个选项——原生 Windows 构建，与这个 shell 同节奏演进（[仓库](https://github.com/unixwin/winuxcmd)）；路径形态、参数传递、与 shell 的配合面都按 shell 语义设计。显而易见的替代品——微软自家的 coreutils 包——是把上游 uutils *打包* 给 PowerShell/CMD 用的（其仓库自述为「Installer & Packaging」，包还在 preview）。它自己的 README 写明了边界：**没有 `/dev/null`**、**没有 POSIX 信号**、`kill` 与 `timeout` 不发货，`chmod`、`chown`、`id`、`tty`、`mkfifo`、`nohup`、`stty` 等二十多个命令以「POSIX-only concepts」为由整批丢弃。给 shell 用的命令层，不能从丢掉 shell 赖以生存的概念开始。 ## 还有「轻量替代」shell 们 新一代 Rust shell 卖的是轻量。同行里：hush 是一门基于 Lua 的语言，从没自称要替代 bash；Oils/OSH 自称「从 bash 升级出去的路径」，不是无感 drop-in。**brush** 宣称的正是 drop-in：「Run it as your everyday shell」「Production-ready for most use cases」。我们用 306 例差分语料（对 GNU Bash 5.3.20 逐字节比对）实测：其发行版 v0.4.0 是 181/306，其 master 最新提交源码构建复测 183/306——同一失败剖面——对照 rubash 在同一把尺子上的 304/306。它丢的全是基础机制，不是边角：alias 时机模型与 GNU 相反（20 探针 6 条实质分歧）；`printf x y` 在发行版上无限循环挂死脚本（master 已修复）；脚本里 `wait $!` 未实现；globstar 被列为「Fully Supported」却不递归；nameref 的 `unset` 报「not yet implemented」——真实的 oh-my-bash 加载正好撞上这一条。它的 Windows 支持自述为「Preview」，v0.4.0 根本没有 Windows 发行二进制。 轻量不是残疾的遮羞布。完整 bash 语义不用 fork 逐路径复刻，加上跨平台本身，是 373,267 净行（rubash 312,965 + niubash 60,302，不含测试，与 rubash README 同一代码规模口径，2026-11-03 实测）的完工价。过不了这些基础机制的实现，既无法成为 bash 的替代产物，也无法成为可靠的登录态 shell。 ## 为 AI agent 而建 模型是按 Bash 训练的；在 Windows 机器上，它们的命令理应由一个「照原文执行」的 shell 来跑。 - **agent 继承 niu 作为 shell。** 从 niu 会话启动的一切都经 `SHELL` 拿到它；[Coding agents on Windows](docs/src/agents.md) 逐个 agent 写明了各自跑什么 shell、怎么把其余的指过来。 - **`--ec`：别跟引号搏斗了，base64 一下。** agent 的命令到达 shell 之前要穿过好几层宿主——每一层都可能弄坏嵌套引号、展开 `$`、吃掉反斜杠。niu 允许你把整条命令编码成一个 base64 字符串再调用——**没有引号，就没有可被弄坏的东西**： ```console # 你想跑的命令： # git log -1 --format="commit %h on %cd" --date="format:%Y-%m-%d" # base64 一下（任何语言一行搞定），然后把这一个字符串交给 niu： $ niu --ec Z2l0IGxvZyAtMSAtLWZvcm1hdD0iY29tbWl0ICVoIG9uICVjZCIgLS1kYXRlPSJmb3JtYXQ6JVktJW0tJWQi commit 58e10d1 on 2026-11-02 ``` 输出和你手敲一模一样——但 agent 全程没写过一个引号。（2026-11-04 在 niubash 检出下实测。）熟悉 PowerShell 的直接用 `-EncodedCommand`（同样的形状，大小写不敏感），`--ec` 是短写。解码器认换行包装、缺 padding、可选 `v1:` 前缀（防 Git-Bash 系层改写路径）。Python / Node / Rust / PowerShell 的完整 cookbook——编码端写法、它消灭的失败模式、载荷上限——见 [Coding agents on Windows](docs/src/agents.md)。 **把 niu 接进你的工具？** 集成只是「拼命令行」处的一行改动——凡代码里拼 `["-c", cmd]` 的地方，改拼 `["--ec", b64]`： ```rust use base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD as B64; use base64::Engine as _; // 之前——命令以裸 argv 传输，任何一层重新加引号、展开或截断都会弄坏调用 c.args(["-c", command]); // 之后——base64 进，命令字节原样到达 niu c.args(["--ec", &B64.encode(command.as_bytes())]); ``` 各宿主语言的换法形状相同。shell 选项照旧放在载荷前面：`niu -eu -o pipefail --ec ` 会让解码后的命令在 `errexit` 和 `pipefail` 下运行。 - **真实的 agent 使用在先。** OpenCode 用户把 `niu.exe` 设为 agent 的 shell，并直接推动了环境变量驱动的 init 工作（[#82](https://github.com/unixwin/niubash/issues/82)）；一处 Hermes 集成故障——字面引号漏进外部命令参数——被立案并修复（[#124](https://github.com/unixwin/niubash/issues/124)）；一天之内三起假基线事故之后，`--version` 现在带构建元数据，agent 永远能确切知道自己在跟哪个构建说话（[rubash#488](https://github.com/unixwin/rubash/issues/488)——实测样例见上文[首跑实测](#首跑实测)）。 - **非交互行为是确定性的。** `niu -c` 与脚本运行安静而稳定：无横幅，stdout/stderr 稳定，退出码精确传播——agent 的工具循环靠的正是这些性质。 - **没有路径轮盘赌。** 没有需要记的 `MSYS_NO_PATHCONV`，没有在子进程背后偷偷改写参数的启发式——`/flags` 还是 `/flags`，路径形操作数按一份成文契约翻译（[windows-path-contract.md](docs/src/windows-path-contract.md)）。 - **agent 技能包随每个 release 已发布：Windows（x64、ARM64）、Linux（x86_64、aarch64；glibc 2.35+）、macOS（aarch64、x86_64）、Android（aarch64、armv7；v1.4.3 起 `.zip` 随 release 发货，真机可运行）。OpenHarmony（aarch64）在 CI 里构建，尚无发布。 - **niu 跑得了真 Bash 脚本吗？** 跑得了。rubash 引擎以 GNU Bash 官方上游测试套件作门禁，记录在[兼容性矩阵](docs/src/rubash-bash-compat-matrix.md)。 - **不止于 Git Bash 兼容。** 控制台设备重定向在连 Git Bash 都失败的地方照常工作：`echo >/dev/tty`、`exec 3<>/dev/tty`、`test -e /dev/tty` 全部与 GNU 一致——引擎把 `/dev/tty` 映射到控制台，并把 `CON` 拆成 `CONIN$`/`CONOUT$` 两半，绕开 Windows 对 `CON` 的设备打开限制（`CON` 上拒绝 `FILE_APPEND_DATA` 与读写打开）。`git`/`ssh` 的 askpass 提示靠的正是这个。（引擎侧线索：[rubash#1312](https://github.com/unixwin/rubash/issues/1312)、[rubash#1314](https://github.com/unixwin/rubash/issues/1314)、[niubash#519](https://github.com/unixwin/niubash/issues/519)。） - **现在能在 Android 或鸿蒙上装 niu 吗？** Android 能：v1.4.3 起 release 自带 `.zip`，真机（Termux aarch64/armv7）可运行。鸿蒙还不能：CI 能编译，但没有可安装产物。 - **niu 用的是哪个 git？niu 的 git 怎么给 pwsh / IDE 用？** 随包 niugit 在 niu 内默认优先（启动时随包目录注入到你的 `PATH` 之前）；设 `NIU_USER_PATH_FIRST=1` 可改让你的 `PATH` 顺序整体优先、你自己装的 git 随之胜出；niubash 之外的程序要直接调随包 niugit，用安装里唯一的 `PATH` 入口目录 `\winuxcmd\bin`，不要把 `usr\bin` 放上 `PATH`。细节与做法见[使用 Git](docs/src/using-git.md)（[#1049](https://github.com/unixwin/niubash/issues/1049)、[#1050](https://github.com/unixwin/niubash/issues/1050)）。 - **从 Git Bash 迁来的脚本里 `cmd //c` 为什么停在提示符？** `//` 是 MSYS 自家参数改写的转义拼写，niu 没有这层改写：双斜杠原样到达 cmd.exe，`//c` 不是 cmd 认识的开关，cmd 于是开一个交互会话——失败形态是挂起，不是报错。写 `cmd /c` 即可——这个在 MSYS 下反而脆弱的拼写，在 niu 下原样可用（[路径契约](docs/src/windows-path-contract.md)）。 ## 已知限制，明说 -
